build_InfiniteDataloader: build an InfiniteDataloader wrapper that restarts iteration and increments epoch when the underlying dataloader is exhausted
create_worker_init_fn: create a worker init function that sets numpy, random, and torch seeds for each dataloader worker
run_validate: run validation on a segmentation model using a val dataloader and return whether metrics improved
run_train_step: run a single training step with forward pass, loss computation, gradient clipping, and optimizer update
run_train_segmentation: run the full segmentation training loop with dataloaders, optimizer, scheduler, validation, and model checkpointing
